document.title: Data Garden Description
document.purpose: Describe the current Data Garden application, its CIRA-shaped boundaries, execution model, data model, and module layout.

summary: Data Garden is a Tkinter-based interactive workspace for arranging simple linked note nodes on a zoomable canvas. The current implementation is a CIRA-shaped desktop prototype: raw GUI input is interpreted by continuity tokenizers and organisms, reduced into semantic events, routed through effects, stored in a durable world model, and rendered by projection code.

execution.default: The default execution path is lionscliapp. After an editable install with pip install -e ., the datagarden executable declares the CLI and dispatches the bare command to the GUI.

startup-options.execpath.firstload: Optional project JSON file to load when the GUI starts. Relative paths resolve from the execution root.

implementation.style: Procedural modules with explicit shared state bundles.
implementation.state-policy: The application keeps canonical mutable dictionaries in data_garden.state. Modules import and mutate those bundles directly inside the trusted interior.

source-layout.data_garden.constants: Application title, colors, node field names, chord bit assignments, and command labels.
source-layout.data_garden.state: Canonical global bundles for raw input, derived facts, organisms, workspace, world, projection, events, effects, immediates, history, and widgets.
source-layout.data_garden.ui: Root window, menu, canvas, inspector panel construction, and Tk event binding.
source-layout.data_garden.continuity.input_and_organis: Tk callback handlers, raw updates, tokenizers, Judge coordination, and interaction organisms.
source-layout.data_garden.discrete.events: Semantic event emission and committed selection helpers.
source-layout.data_garden.discrete.reducer: Semantic event reducer, command reducer, and effect routing.
source-layout.data_garden.world.model: Node creation, cloning, deletion, updates, world revision deltas, geometry helpers, and revision navigation.
source-layout.data_garden.projection.camera: Screen/world coordinate conversion and hit picking.
source-layout.data_garden.projection.render: Projection refresh, grid drawing, node drawing, selection drawing, marquee preview, and visual previews.
source-layout.data_garden.inspector: Inspector refresh, field application, color/link/delete/clone commands, and status updates.
source-layout.data_garden.file_ops: New/open/save operations, JSON normalization, project dump/load, and atomic JSON writes.
source-layout.data_garden.history: Undo/redo snapshots, restoration, and continuity reset after time jumps.
source-layout.data_garden.runtime: Runtime cycle pumping and GUI main loop.
source-layout.data_garden.wiring: First-pass procedural namespace wiring after the monolith split.

owns: grid, node, selection, and marquee rendering

canvas-behaviors: left drag empty canvas marquee selection
inspector-behaviors: edit selected node title, url, fill, dimensions, angle, and note

notes: The first modular pass preserves the original procedural function names and shared mutable state rather than introducing classes.
data_garden.wiring is intentionally transitional: it lets section modules resolve cross-section function calls while retaining the monolith's trusted-interior style.
Future cleanup can reduce wiring pressure by moving a few cross-layer calls behind explicit small APIs.
